name: Symmachus
biography: Pagan Prefect of Rome who led the senatorial petition for restoring the Altar of Victory, opposed and defeated by Ambrose; later reappears, via his grandson (father-in-law of Boethius), connecting this chapter's Rome to the world of Chapter V.
